header: Amazon OpenSearch Service user interface release history
content:
The following table lists all releases of the Amazon OpenSearch Service support for OpenSearch UI
and the features and enhancements included with each release.
Change
Release date
Description
New
feature
2025-04-16
OpenSearch UI now works with cross-cluster search. This
makes it possible for you to use OpenSearch UI in one AWS
Region to access clusters in a diﬀerent Region. This is done
by conﬁguring it as a remote cluster connected with a cluster
in the same Region. For more information, see the section
called “Cross-Region and cross-account data access with
cross-cluster search”.
New
feature
2025-03-31
Amazon Q Developer is now generally available in Amazon
OpenSearch Service. For information, see Amazon Q support.
